Tough review. They have great care and service. But I gotta be honest, the franchise as a whole has a lot of overhead and you pay for it as a customer. Firstly, there's a consult fee that you have to pay and it's only good for a set period of time. Then you have to bring your pet back for whatever appointment. In my case I had my cat needed shots, and they put it on you to do the research of what shots you want (don't really look out for you). In my specific case I just needed the baseline shots but they tried to ask us for more that we did not need. Reality is you can pay for those same shots through other networks for the price of the consult fee.
Ultimately, I think you're paying way too much for convenience at Vetco and the fact that the consult fee does not go towards the actual medical procedure you want is wildly absurd. In this economy I would advise you to do the research and look into alternatives. If you don't mind paying a lot of extra for care for your pet, then they will do right by you.

It has taken me a long time to write this review because the pain of losing my dog, has been incredibly difficult to process. This incident happened some time ago, but I feel it’s important to share so that others are aware and hopefully spared from a similar tragedy.

I am heartbroken to say that my dog died due to negligence at this clinic. My dog was seen twice in one week, and days after the second visit, I received a voicemail stating that the label for one of his medications— "did not get all the instructions". When I returned their call, I was given the correct dosage he should had been receiving, but this critical information was never provided at the time I received the medication.
Unfortunately by the time they contacted me, the damage had been done. My dog had passed due to not receiving the proper medication.
What made the situation even more painful was the complete lack of compassion. Once I mentioned my dog had died, I was met with no apology, no sympathy, and no acknowledgment of the gravity of the situation. Not a single “I’m sorry.”

Losing my dog in this way was devastating — and completely preventable! This kind of mistake is inexcusable when it comes to medical care, especially for our pets who rely on us and the professionals we trust for their well-being.

Please be extremely cautious when dealing with this clinic. Double-check every medication, and don’t assume anything has been communicated properly. Your pet’s life may depend on it.
